name: Aoyama Midori
source: A female novelist who goes under the pen name of Aoyama Blue Mountain. She admired Chino's grandfather (who she affectionately calls "Master") and always asked his opinion about her stories. She briefly stopped writing books after she lost a pen that was given to her by Chino's grandfather, and Chino gave her a temporary job in the Rabbit House. Named after Jamaican Blue Mountain Coffee.
